posts.cooked:
I am unable to connect to my virtual machine. I am getting an error. Please help me resolve it as soon as possible, as I need to do BPT 1.
@hemalatha
@AtulPS
@Afnan_POD
@Puneet_21f3002005
@21f1002877
@chaitanya353535

Screenshot 2025-01-24 215430858×287 11.2 KB

posts.name: Puneet
posts.cooked:
Hi,

Please do not worry, follow these instructions.

  1. Open the terminal, write ssh-keygen.
  2. It will ask to overwrite, type y.
  3. Complete the process.
  4. Do cd .ssh and then write the command ls.
  5. If you have any other file than the id_ed25519 and id_ed25519.pub. Then delete them using command rm <filename>.
  6. Once you have done this, do cat id_ed25519.pub. Copy the key given by this file.
  7. Paste it and designated place. Then open your terminal and ssh into your VM.

posts.name: Aditya Roongta
posts.cooked:
Hi,

I too am facing issues logging in to VM. I accessed my SSH key by opening the .pub file from the Users//.ssh/ folder. I got the following key but not sure if it is the right key.
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIEVhuDZFurt2xXeGumKpWpfmmNYV57xwbcbJO57O3wsP adityaroongta@Adityas-MacBook-Pro.local

I entered the above key in the form field ‘SSH Key’. On the next page, it showed a message ‘SSH key updated successfully for 21f1000963’, followed by the below text.

Login using SSH key

  • Go to https://se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in/passwordless and complete the form as per the instructions given.
  • After submitting the SSH key, you can login to the VM using SSH from your system.
    • Make sure the directory ~/.ssh with file permission 700
    • Make sure the files ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub and ~/.ssh/id_rsa with file permission 600.

The below command used to connect remote machine via SSH with default private key (~/.ssh/id_rsa)

ssh 21f1000963@se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in

The below command used to connect remote machine via SSH with custom private key path. Note that path/to/private/key is the placeholder for the path to the private key file.

ssh -i path/to/private/key 21f1000963@se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in
  • Then you can login to the remote VM with password.
  • Read more about SSH Click here

On clicking the first link, it takes me back to the first page where I had submitted the key.

Can someone please help me?

Thanks & Regards
Aditya
